content.title: No 16-year-old in goal! - Confirmed UCL lineups: FC Bayern Munich vs. Atalanta Bergamo
content.text: Europe: Champions LeagueMar 18 20:00March 18, 2026 at 20:00FTFC BayernAtalanta⚽ H. Kane (25), ⚽ H. Kane (54), ⚽ Lennart Karl (56), ⚽ L. Díaz (70) @michaelkryschakMar 18 18:52March 18, 2026 at 18:52 Here are the confirmed UCL lineups for the match between FC Bayern Munich and Atalanta Bergamo. FC Bayern team photo.Photo: Marco Luzzani / Getty Images. Speculation had been building, but now it’s official: there will be no surprise in goal for Bayern Munich against Atalanta Bergamo, as Jonas Urbig has recovered in time to start between the sticks.Following injuries to Manuel Neuer a few weeks ago, Sven Ulreich on Saturday, and Urbig himself last week, many had expected 16-year-old prodigy Leonard Prescott to make his professional debut.Atalanta face a daunting task, with Bayern holding a commanding 6-1 advantage from the first leg. With just under an hour until kick-off, here are the confirmed lineups for both teams:Confirmed UCL lineups: FC Bayern Munich vs. Atalanta BergamoFC Bayern (4-2-3-1):Urbig - Stanišić, Kim, Tah, Bischof - Pavlović, Goretzka - Karl, Guerreiro, Díaz - KaneAtalanta Bergamo (3-4-2-1):Sportiello - Kossounou, Hien, Scalvini - Bellanova, Éderson, Pašalić, Bernasconi - De Ketelaere, Sulemana - ScamaccaKompany analyses Vini Junior incidentVincent Kompany analysed the racism scandal surrounding Vinicius Junior, which he witnessed live during the match between Benfica and Real Madrid.0 seconds of 1 minute, 26 secondsVolume 0%
